Commentary.Commentary: If momentum is anything in sports, it's currently with Pakistan. They will be delighted with their performance in the last section of the innings and would like to carry that forward into their chase. The touring party has been doing quite a decent job with the bat and a target of 352 against an inconsistent English bowling attack looks pretty much gettable. Should be a riveting chase. Do join us in a short while.

The bowling and fielding were abysmal again from Pakistan. But once their bowlers started to pull things back, we witnessed some excellent death bowling and a few brilliant stops in the field. Shaheen Afridi picked the most number of wickets, i.e. 4 but the standout bowler for Pakistan was Imad Wasim. He snapped 3 wickets by conceding just 53 runs and played a big role in restricting England during that period post the 35th over mark.

Starting from the start, it was yet another usual start from the home team. Their openers wasted no time in attacking the Pakistan bowlers. The way they were going hammer and tongs, the social media was buzzing with a total of 500 for England. But, the English batsmen kept on throwing their wickets after getting starts and due to that the charge needed in the death overs never came. Eventually, it was Tom Curran's cameo with the bat that forced England's total past the 350-run mark.

351/9 is a big score and also reflects on the bowling of a team. But what it doesn't tell is the comeback that the bowling team made. England were going great guns since the beginning and the century stand between Root and Morgan further stamped their dominance. The latter departed in the 30th over, followed by the wicket of the former in the 36th over and that was the point from where the visiting team made a superb comeback. Given the firepower that England have in their batting, conceding less than a hundred in the last 15 overs is a commendable effort from Pakistan.
Another excellent yorker on middle, Curran can only manage to jam it out towards the leg side by bringing his bat down in time. Only a run can be picked up. ENGLAND FINISH WITH 351/9!

Yorker on middle, jammed out by Curran. The ball goes off the inside edge and to the left of the keeper. Curran declines the easy single that was available there. He wants to face the final ball. What can he do?

FOUR! Incredible shot! The 350 comes up for the hosts! A slower ball, back off a length, Curran looks to paddle this over short third man initially but seeing the ball arrive really late and straight, Tom improvises and scoops the ball over the keeper in the end. Picks up another valuable boundary.

SIX! Hammered right back over the bowler's head for a flat six. A length ball, slower in pace, Curran reads it and picks the bones out of that one. The poor sightscreen has to bear the brunt of that shot.
Good fielding! A length ball on middle, Curran hits the ball over the bowler's head. The long on fielder comes around and keeps it in. Two runs saved.
Fuller length ball outside off, Rashid backs away and hits the ball to deep cover for a run. He gets Curran on strike, more importantly.
Full toss on middle stump, Rashid turns this ball towards mid-wicket. A single has been taken. He will have strike for the last over.
Adil Rashid is the number 11 batsman.

OUT! You miss, I hit! A fuller one on off, Willey backs away and looks to hit the ball but misses it completely. The ball goes on to knock the off stump. Good bowling to the lower order batsman. That is Afridi's 4th wicket, he has been expensive today but he has picked up important wickets too.
Willey gets a bottom edge towards the keeper to this length ball wide outside off.

SIX! A one-handed six from Willey! Full length ball outside off, slower in pace. David looks to hit it over long off, the blade turns in his hands. He still gets enough power to get the ball over the rope there.
Full toss outside off, hit back towards mid off by Curran. The ball goes straight to the fielder who has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit, Tom was a goner.
Misses out there! A full toss outside off, Curran looks to hit the ball but fails to put bat on it.
Nails his shot but only for a run. Top over by Hasan, six singles from it. A low full toss on middle, Curran heaves it over mid-wicket and it goes on one bounce to the fielder in the deep.
A lovely yorker on off, Willey digs it out to covers and picks another run in the over.
Shortish and on off, slower in pace, Curran pushes it from the shoulder of his bat towards covers for a run.
Third man comes up.
A low full toss outside off, David drills it through the line but finds the mid off fielder. A single taken.
Digs in a short ball on middle, it's pulled behind square leg for a run.
Fullish and on the pads, Willey flicks it off the inner half of his bat to short fine leg and pinches a single.

FOUR! Just over short third man! England getting some valuable runs here. A really full ball outside off, Curran looks to smash this through covers but gets an outside edge. The ball flies over the head of short third man and for a boundary. Curran will not mind how the runs come as long as they do.
Low full toss outside off, Curran drives this through covers for a couple of runs as the fielder in the deep mops up.

SIX! That is a simply outstanding shot. What hand-eye coordination! A low full toss on middle, Curran comes inside the line before ramping it over the keeper's head. The ball flies into the sightscreen there.
Tom Curran hits this ball towards mid-wicket.
Shorter outside off, punched to deep cover for a single by the southpaw. Single taken.
On a length outside off, Willey drives the ball towards cover.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run to end a 6-run over which also fetched the wicket of Ben Stokes.
Tom Curran walks out at number 10!

OUT! Ben falls. Pakistan are doing very well by taking wickets at regular intervals. Hasan Ali delivers it with a scrambled seam and digs it in short on middle. Stokes takes on the challenge to pull it into the stand at long on but fails to generate enough power behind his shot. The ball balloons in the air and Fakhar Zaman moves swiftly across to his left from long on to complete the catch safely.
FOUR! Whacked! It's not a bad delivery, just a fraction short of the blockhole, Stokes uses the depth of his crease and then clears his front leg before whipping it to the wide long on fence.
Stays back footed to a shortish ball and punches it on the off side.
Fullish and outside off, Willey drives it through covers and takes a single. Stokes wants the second but slips while turning for it.

Good fielding, Hasnain! All of a sudden, Pakistan are doing everything better than they were doing earlier. Slower short ball on middle, Stokes nails his pull shot through square leg. Hasnain in the deep moves across to his right and picks up the ball in one motion before returning it to the keeper. Only one taken.
Willey pushes this ball wide of point as well as third man. A couple of runs are taken.
Stokes angles this wide one outside half for a single to third man.
Guided down to third man now for a single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. One run added to the total. The 300 comes up with that shot!

FOUR! That is so unlucky for the fielder. A fuller length ball outside off, Stokes hits it through cover. The fielder there dives to stop the ball but gets a bad bounce and it goes over the fielder. It reaches the fence as well. This is the second time that a wicket has been followed by a boundary.
David Willey walks out now.

OUT! Woakes goes now! Shaheen has three now. A fuller length ball on off, Chris looks to smash this one but the bat twists in his hand and the ball goes off the inside half. It lobs towards mid off where Babar Azam takes an easy catch. This is a terrific fightback from Pakistan!
Shaheen Afridi comes back now.
Top edges this short length ball on middle, the ball goes on a bounce to deep fine leg. Single taken and CW will have strike in the next over.
Brilliant run! A yorker on off, Stokes keeps the ball out by bringing his bat down in time. A quick single is taken though!
Stokes defends this ball which is really full on the off stump line towards cover.
A towel is out here with some spray as well. Probably, Stokes is not able to grip the bat well with some hand sweat.
Woakes drives this one to long on for a run.
Off the top half of the bat and there is absolutely no timing whatsoever. The short ball is pulled but only lobs over mid-wicket. Long on comes around and stops the batsmen from taking three.
Back of a length on the hips, tucked away through mid-wicket for a single.
Dot ball to finish! A superb over this, just 4 off it in the end. 8 runs off Imad's last 3 overs! He finishes his bowling spell today with figures of 10-0-53-3!
Stokes manages to get this punch shot past mid on for a single.
Pushed off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good fielding! Saves 1 run for his team. A flatter one outside off, Woakes cuts it away to the left of deep point but Asif Ali there runs around and keeps it just in. Three runs are taken though.
Flatter on off, Woakes comes ahead and keeps the ball off the outside half towards point.
Woakes punches this ball to sweeper cover. He keeps strike.
Stokes comes down the track and hits the ball down the ground for another run at long off.
Woakes goes for the same shot like the one earlier in this over. This time he keeps the ball along the ground for a single to long on.
Driven through mid off by the southpaw. The batsmen have run through for a single.

DROPPED! That was a return catch and it has been put down. A flatter one on off, Woakes pushes the ball back to the right of the bowler. Hafeez should have really taken that one, it was a regulation catch even though he had to move a little to his right. The ball goes through his hands and for a single down to long on. Pakistan's poor catching in this series continues!
Flatter on off, punched to deep cover for a single.
Mohammad Hafeez comes back on to bowl.
Full and fast on middle, driven to mid-wicket by Woakes. A 3-run over from a spinner, Sarfaraz will take it anytime of the day!
Punched off the back foot by the batsman to long on. Single picked up.
Another one flicked straight to the fielder on the leg side. Just 2 runs off the first 4 balls of this over.
Stokes punches this ball towards mid-wicket.
Flatter outside off, pushed back to long off for a single.
Imad fires this one flatter and quicker on off, Stokes turns it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Powerplay 3 time! A maximum of 5 fielders can be kept outside the 30-yard circle now till the end of the innings.

Off the top edge but lands well short of deep fine leg! A bouncer on middle, Stokes with a half-hearted pull. The ball goes off the top edge and fine on the leg side. It lands well short of the fielder in the deep. A single is taken.
Stokes struggling with his timing here. Outside off on a length, Ben looks to cut but the ball goes off the under edge and to the keeper.
Wide! Bowled down the leg side and it is penalized by the umpire.
On a length outside off, pushed by Stokes to mid off coming forward.
Short and outside off, tapped down to third man by Woakes. He gets off the strike and gets Stokes back on.
Back of a length on middle, Woakes adjusts and defends very awkwardly back on the surface.
So close to the outside edge! A length ball outside off, Woakes fishes at the ball looking to cut but the ball whizzes past the outside edge. Could have so easily been caught behind.
Woakes gets off the mark with a single down to fine leg. The ball was quick and full on the pads, flicked away fine by the batsman. End of a superb over, 2 wickets and a single run in it!
Fired in on middle, driven towards mid on by Chris.
Flatter on middle and off, Woakes comes ahead and defends the ball back towards the bowler.
Chris Woakes is the new batsman. He is no mug with the bat, in fact, no one is mug with the bat in this England's deep bating line-up with Adil Rashid slotted to bat at number 11. That's some luxury.

OUT! Three reds and Moeen Ali has to depart. He will take the review along with him as well. He has been caught plumb in front, missing a pretty straightforward off spinner by playing down the wrong line. A flatter off spinner landing outside off and spinning into the southpaw, Moeen looks to push the ball down the ground but misses the line completely. He does not get bat on it and gets rapped in front of the wickets. The appeal comes up and so does the finger after a bit of thinking. Moeen reviews in hope but it does not save him as the replays show us he was a dead duck. Third wicket for Imad, he is being a hero here.
Ali has been adjudged LBW here but he has reviewed. It looked pretty adjacent to the naked eye. Will height be a factor?
Fired in wide outside off, Ali looks to reach the ball and drive it but fails to put bat on ball.
Moeen Ali is the new batsman.

OUT! Big wicket! Huge moment in the game! This could be the difference between a 360 and a 400! Shorter one outside off, Buttler looks to cut it but fails to keep the ball down. It flies to the left of point where Abid Ali reaches out and holds on to a sharp catch. This could be Pakistan's big opportunity to come back and limit England to a total that they can realistically chase down with Buttler gone and two relatively new men out in the middle.
On the shorter side once more, Buttler tucks it through square leg for a single. Another decent over for the visitors, just 5 off it.

Good running! Short of a length ball on off, Buttler mistimes his pull to the left of deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second run. They complete it with ease, so quick between the wickets these two.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length and pacy on the hips, Stokes misses his glance and cops a blow on his sides. The ball lobs fine on the leg side for a solitary leg bye.

Back of a length outside off, Stokes looks to guide it to the left of the slip fielder who has been placed for him. The ball though goes off the top half of the bat and towards the slip fielder on a bounce.
Back of a length outside off, Buttler taps the ball towards point with soft hands and exchanges strike with a quick single.
End of a good over from Imad. Just 2 off it in the end. A flatter one to end the over, pushed to deep cover for a single by Jos as he retains strike for the next over.
Flatter on the pads, Buttler runs this fine on the leg side but not fine enough to beat the short fine leg fielder.
Stokes gets off the mark with a pushy drive to long on.
Another flighted ball outside off, BS comes ahead and pushes the ball back towards the bowler.
Flighted outside off, Stokes looks to drive but the ball goes off the outside edge towards short third man.
Flatter to Stokes first up, pushed back towards mid-wicket by Ben.

FOUR! That is so deft from Buttler. A back of a length ball on off, Jos waits for the ball to arrive before just opening the face of the bat and angling it really fine to the left of third man. This is just pure skill and class of the man. Also tells you about the form of a person.
Bouncer on middle, JB ducks under the ball and lets it go.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Short and wide outside off, Buttler cuts this with venom past point. Beats third man with ease. Easy pickings.
Ben Stokes walks in at number 6.

OUT! Root holes out! He did not get enough power on that shot. A short ball outside off, Root pulls this over mid-wicket. Wanted to hit a biggie but just did not get the power on that. The ball goes right down the throat of Asif Ali in the deep there. End of a really entertaining innings from England's maestro. Misses out on a well-deserved 100!

In the air... but lands safely! Buttler would have had his heart in his mouth there. A short ball on middle, Jos looks to pull it over deep mid-wicket but the ball goes off the top edge and high towards fine leg. The ball lands in no man's land. A single is taken again.
Short of a length on middle, a controlled pull to deep square leg from Root. Single picked up.

Drinks break. England continue to go great guns here. They have lost three wickets but their run rate is still over 7 and they will be eyeing a score close to 400, if not more. Joe Root is inching closer to his century, while Jos Buttler is taking his time to settle down. We all know if Jos lasts the distance, the final score can be massive. Pakistan have to limit the damage in the final 15 overs to stand any chance of chasing down the total. Mohammad Hasnain to bowl after the mini-break.

Dot again. Too full in length and outside off, Buttler drills his drive this time but once again fails to beat the cover fielder. Wasim does well to concede just 5 in the over after going for a boundary first ball.
Buttler has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A front foot cover drive on this occasion by Buttler but he finds the fielder inside the ring.
Arm ball on off, skidding back in, Buttler is forward to play straight but it takes the inside half of the bat and goes to mid-wicket.
Quicker and flatter on middle, Root is deep inside the crease as he tickles it in front of square leg for one.
FOUR! Root greets Imad with an innovative boundary. Flatter and fuller delivery outside off, Joe is down on one knee as he reverse paddles it wide of short third man.
Imad Wasim returns into the attack.
Goes searching for a blockhole but a low full toss is all that Shaheen finds. Jos pushes it down to mid on to end the 9-run over with a dot!
Buttler picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
250 up for England. This one is drilled through covers and the fielder in the deep makes a fine stop. Still a couple taken.

SIX! Extraordinary shot! Buttler showing his raw power there. The delivery is on the shorter side outside off, Jos hangs on the back foot and gives it the full whack of his bat over extra cover. It flies and flies and flies to clear the fence.
Short again but this time the line is quite straight, Root crouches a bit and pulls it behind square leg for one.
Shortish and on off, Root taps it down from the crease to point.
Stays on the back foot and punches a length ball to covers. Top over by Hasan, just 3 coming off it.

Almost drags it on! Slower delivery, on a length and close to off stump, Buttler picks it late and tries to defend close to his body. Gets an inside edge onto the pads and it rolls behind to the keeper.
A confident off drive from Buttler but the mid off fielder does well to stop it to his left. No run.
Width on offer outside off, Root goes on his toes and steers it through cover-point for a run.
Gets forward to cover the line of a full ball and drives it down to mid on.
Shortish and wide outside off, Root cuts it through point for a brace.

FOUR! Boom! Afridi changes his angle for the last delivery. Switches to 'round the wicket and bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, Buttler pulls it easily behind square leg for a boundary. 10 from the over!
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
A full toss on off, Buttler drives it square of the wicket on the off side and picks up a single.
Digs in a short ball on off, Buttler sways away from the line.
Drifting down the leg side, on a good length, Jos tries to flick but misses. It clips his thigh pad and flies behind. Sarfaraz jumps to his left to stop the ball, although not cleanly.

FOUR! Shot of a batsman in prime form! Nothing much wrong with the delivery, just too good a shot. A good length ball on middle, Buttler plants his back leg inside the crease and then crunches it through the gap between extra cover and mid off.
On middle, easily helped behind square leg for one.
Lands it on a length around off, Jos is forward as he defends it to the off side.
Wide! Hasan tries to go a notch up in his pace but ends up delivering a full ball down the leg side. Buttler tries his best to get some bat behind it but fails.
Short and on off, Buttler turns inside the crease with the pull shot but fails to middle it properly. It rolls down safely to mid-wicket.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
A length ball on off, angling in, Buttler works it wide of mid on and crosses to the other end.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Buttler walks across the stumps to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Hasan Ali is back into the attack. A slip in place for Buttler.
Sliding down the leg side, Jos uses his wrists and works it behind square leg to get off the mark with a run.
Back of a length delivery angling away from the new batsman, Buttler drops his wrists and allows it through to the keeper.
Too full in length on middle and leg, angling down, Root clips it through square leg and runs the first run hard. He is interested in the second run also, but it's not on.
Jos Buttler walks out now to bat.

OUT! Morgan has fallen to a short delivery! Double Nelson strikes. The English skipper tries to fetch the delivery from wide outside off and play the pull shot but it takes the top edge and flies in the air. Abid Ali runs across to his left from mid-wicket and completes the catch. A massive breakthrough for Pakistan to break the 117-run stand. The short ball has done the trick again, 2nd time in this innings. Maybe a ploy for teams to use in flat decks such as these. Meanwhile, Shaheen celebrates again like Shahid Afridi used to do.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off, there to be hit, Morgan chases but fails to connect.
Starts his spell with a short ball on middle, Root pulls it down to fine leg for a run.
Shaheen Afridi is back on. He has been very expensive today in his four overs prior to this. Can he redeem himself?
Slower through the air on middle and turning into Morgan, he keeps it out towards mid-wicket.
Punched from the crease by the batsman back down to the bowler.
SIX! Stand and deliver stuff! A flighted ball outside off, Morgan smashes this one over long off and clears the fence with such ease. The England skipper is turning on things here.
Root turns this ball around the corner for a single.
Driven through mid on by the skipper. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! That is huge! A flighted ball outside off, Morgan runs down the track and lifts this way over the cow corner. The ball ends up in the stands.
Yet another single to end the over. Flatter on mid-wicket, Morgan pushes this to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Root stands tall and punches this away for a single.
The 100-run stand comes up! A flatter one outside off, driven through cover for a single.
Shorter on middle, pulled away by Root through square leg for a single.
Shorter one outside off, Morgan punches this ball through covers for a single.
Flatter on middle, defended back to the bowler by Morgan.
Root keeps this ball out from the crease.
Morgan flicks this ball to the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Pushed to the left of cover by Root and a single is taken.
Root cuts this ball late outside off but finds the point fielder.
200 up for England! A flatter one on the pads, tucked through mid-wicket and picks up a run does Morgan.
Flat and short on off, punched to sweeper cover for a run.
Imad Wasim is back into the attack.
Driven back to the bowler this time.
FOUR! Crunched away! A short one wide outside off, Morgan cuts this away behind point. Easily beats the fielder in the deep and picks up a boundary just as the pressure was slightly building.
Short outside off, Morgan looks to cut this one away but the ball goes off the top of the bat and back towards the bowler.
Root turns this ball away through square leg for a run.
Cut away to deep point for a run by the southpaw.
Flighted outside off, Root eases this ball down to long on for a single.
Slower bouncer this time, around off, Morgan waits for it to come and then pulls it in front of square leg for a run.
Speedy delivery! Back of a length ball around middle and off, angling away, Morgan is early into his pull shot and misses. It clips his jersey and goes behind to the keeper.
Full and around leg, Morgan covers the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Some extra bounce this time, on middle, Morgan tries defending but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.

FOUR! Crunched! Morgan reaches his 44th ODI fifty with an imperious cover driver. Hasnain pitches it just up outside off and Eoin has creamed it through the gap on the off side. Both batsmen looking set for a big one here as England continue to march forward.
Angles in a length ball on off, Root gets behind the line and pushes it in front of square on the off side for a run.
Worked in front of square leg for a run by Root and he retains strike for the next over. 7 runs off this over.
Driven down to long off this time for a run by the southpaw.
Flatter on off, pushed back to the bowler.

FOUR! Not the best timing but the ball is in the gap and beats the fielder in the deep. A short ball on middle, pulled over deep mid-wicket. The ball goes to the right of the deep fielder and beats him to the rope.
Morgan looks to slog this ball from the crease but fails to get proper connection. The ball rolls towards mid-wicket.
Flatter on off, pulled away for a single to deep mid-wicket by Root.
Good comeback from the bowler! Hasnain hits the blockhole, Morgan does well to dig it out back to the bowler.

SIX! Not quite from the middle of the blade but it has gone into the stands. The bowler digs in a short ball around leg, Morgan turns and pulls it across the line. It flies off the top edge and sails over backward square leg for a maximum.
Fuller and on off, driven through wide mid off for a run.
Short and on top of off stump, Eoin stands tall inside the crease and guides it down to third man for a run.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Morgan tries flicking but misses.
Around off on a good length, it's defended off the back foot to covers.
Good length ball angling into the batsman from 'round the wicket, Morgan defends it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. No run to end the over.
Presses forward and drives it through covers for a run.
Morgan has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SIX! Second for England and second from the bat of Morgan as well. Shortish ball on middle, Moggie stays back footed and pummels it over mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Lovely placement! Shortish and on off, Root sits down on one knee and sweeps it firmly to bisect the two fielders deep on the leg side. A boundary at mid-wicket results.
Quietly plays it down to mid-wicket and keeps strike with himself.
Quicker one on the pads, helped to square leg for one.
SIX! First of the innings! Fakhar serves it full and around off, Morgan spots that mid off is up an hence chips it over the in-ring fielder. Times it beautifully and it has gone all the way.
A full toss this time, Root leans forward and bunts it down to long off for a run.
Another back foot punch by Root but he finds the extra cover fielder.
Flat and short on off, Root remains on the back foot and punches it to covers.
Stays on the back foot and turns it through square leg for a run.
Hangs on the back foot to a short ball and punches it down to long off for one.
Flighted on off, defended back to the bowler.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Shortish again, on off, stroked down past the bowler to long off for a single.
FOUR! Chipped away with ease! Slightly short in length on middle by Shoaib, Morgan goes deep inside the crease and lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Easily done! A flatter and shorter delivery around leg, Root goes down on one knee and sweeps it effortlessly behind square leg for a boundary. 30th ODI fifty for Joe as the crowd goes Rooooootttttt!
Flatter on middle, pushed down to long on for one.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it back to the bowler.

Loopy and full outside off, Root presses forward and drives it through covers. Hafeez in the deep moves across to his right and puts in a dive but fails to stop the ball. A good back up done by Asif Ali coming in from wide long off as he stops the ball from reaching the fence. A run is saved eventually.
Quicker one on the pads, helped on the leg side but straight to mid on.

Aerial but safe! A tossed up ball on off, Morgan tries to go inside-out over covers but ends up mistiming it over mid off. 'Catch it' is the shout from Sarfaraz but it falls in no man's land in the deep. A couple taken to end the over.
Flighted one, landing full on middle, Morgan lunges and defends it back to the bowler.
Tickles it off his pads in front of square leg and picks up a single.
Goes short and wide outside off, Morgan slaps it to the left of the sweeper cover fielder for one more. Doing it in singles, this pair.
Flatter again, on middle, Root works it through mid-wicket and collects another run.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched down to long off for a run.
DRINKS BREAK.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for one more.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, hit through the covers for one.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
The batsman delicately works it fine down the leg side.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket.
Thrown up outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
On middle, pushed towards the bowler.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Down the leg side, helped through the leg side for one more.
Shoaib Malik into the attack now.
On middle, pushed through mid on for a run. Decent start from Fakhar.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
On middle, Morgan chips this uppishly, wide of the bowler, towards long on for a single.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
Wow. Desperation stuff from Sarfaraz. Fakhar Zaman to bowl his left-arm orthodox.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Pushes this through mid on for a run.
Down the leg side, glanced through the vacant leg slip area towards fine leg for a couple.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Short and outside off, cut through point for one.
Short and around middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Outside off, Root punches this on the up through the covers for a couple. It was a late call to go for the second and Joe had to dive in. Replays show that while turning blind for the second, Root almost swiped Hasan with his bat who had to jump to avoid getting hit. That cost Root an extra second but he managed to get in.
Landed outside off, cut behind point for a single.
Outside off, Root flashes hard but edges it straight to short third man. Wow... stop the press. A boundary-less over.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
On middle and leg, this is worked past short fine leg for a single.
Around middle and leg, turned straight to short fine leg.
Skipper Eoin Morgan walks in at number 4, replacing Bairstow.

OUT! Caught! 'Oh no! England won't get to 500 now,' cries my colleague Predicto. Hard luck. But is he so sure? 495 runs in 39 overs. With this England batting line-up, isn't ANYTHING possible? Anyways, Bairstow throws it away. And he does not look too disappointed. Because every English batsman is simply looking to enjoy himself and score runs at will. Full on middle, Bairstow looks to go through the line but does not quite connect cleanly. Finds Shaheen Afridi at long on who does not have to move an inch.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary to end the over. Outside off, short in length, Bairstow punches it on the rise through the covers. Mohammad Hafeez starts to run to his right but then lets it through.
Around off, pushed straight to mid on.
Outside off, driven back to the bowler who leaps and half-stops it.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Solid shot. Full and around off, Root drives this straight down the ground, beating mid on.
POWERPLAY 2 time. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Hasan Ali is back on. 2-1-16-0 so far.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. 95/1 in Powerplay 1. Absolute carnage.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Another edge! No slip again. Outside off, Root looks to defend but the ball spins away, takes the outside edge and goes through the vacant slip region. Where? Don't you know?
FOUR! Another boundary. Landed outside off, Root looks to play the reverse paddle but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat. Who cares? No slip and it is a boundary.
Around middle and off, worked past short mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Poor start. Down the leg side, Bairstow tickles it to the fine leg fence.
Imad Wasim into the attack now.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Full and around off, driven nicely but straight to mid on.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Root glances it to the fine leg fence!
Around off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Not quite in control but Root will take it. A short ball, around middle, Root looks to pull but mistimes it over square leg. No on in the deep.

FOUR! Short and outside off, Root punches this to the right of cover. Shoaib Malik gets across to his right but lets it through. That distracts Hasan Ali who comes to his left and slides but cannot quite stop it. The ball goes through and a boundary is taken.
Pushes this through mid on for a run.

Excellent stop by Imad Wasim. Nothing much on the Free Hit. Full and outside off, Jonny bashes it from the crease through mid off but Imad dives to his left and saves a certain boundary. Just a single.
FREE HIT for Bairstow. Will he play any shot which is not in the textbook?
NO BALL! Afridi oversteps and bowls it on a length around off, Root looks to drive it through the off side but the ball swings in and goes off the inner half wide of mid on. A single taken.

ALMOST DISMISSED FIRST BALL! A short ball, around middle, Root looks to pull but gets a top edge which goes over short fine leg. Fakhar Zaman cannot quite get to it before the gravitational force completes its effect and a couple are taken.
Joe Root walks in at number 3, replacing Vince. He has been getting too many starts of late and would want a big score today.

OUT! Vince holes out. A good short ball, around middle, James looks to pull but the bounce does him in. Gets a top edge which balloons towards deep square leg. Fakhar Zaman runs to his left from deep backward square leg and takes it calmly. Vince will be disappointed. Again, he got a start but failed to convert.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Vince tucks it to the fine leg fence.

WIDE. Didn't that hit something? Thought there was a noise heard. Full and down the leg side, Bairstow missed his flick and the ball supposedly went past everything to the keeper behind. Sarfaraz once again fumbled and conceded a run.
A short ball, outside off, Vince slashes hard and almost cuts it straight to third man. The fielder stops it on the bounce and a single is taken.
Around off, punched behind point for a single. Ends the over in a much better manner than he started. 9 from the first legal ball, just 2 from the next legal 5.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Pushes this straight to mid on.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Poor bowling again. Short and wide outside off, Bairstow punches it past point for a boundary!
FIVE WIDES! Bonus by Pakistan. A full ball, down the leg side, Bairstow misses his flick and Sarfaraz, in spite of a dive, cannot stop it. Parries it to the fine leg fence.
Mohammad Hasnain will be looking to pick up a wicket or two here.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
A terrific yorker, outside off, James looks to steer it to third man but misses. Afridi appeals for a catch but Sarfaraz himself is not interested.
A change of bats for Jonny Bairstow. Looks like the previous one was broken.

TOP EDGE, BUT SAFE! England might play in a casino tonight and win every game that they play. A short ball, around middle, right at the body, Bairstow looks to pull but is hurried into the shot. Gets a top edge, with the bottom hand coming off the bat. It lobs in the air but goes past Sarfaraz. Hasan Ali gets around from short fine leg and keeps the batsmen to a single.
FOUR! Poor bowling. Down the leg side, Bairstow just helps it to the fine leg fence.
Outside off, watchfully steered towards third man for a run.
Excellent yorker, around leg stump, dug out towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Good consistency in terms of bowling that one bad ball per over. After bowling a wonderful over so far, Hasnain strays on the pads and Vince tucks it through backward square leg.
More inswing, on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

Oh Lady Luck, when will you start supporting Pakistan? This is a beauty of a delivery by the young kid but has got no luck whatsoever. Full and around off, swinging in a long way, Bairstow plays all around it, looking to flick but the ball swings in late, takes the outside edge and goes through the vacant gully position towards third man! A single taken.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
FOUR! It is raining boundaries. A short ball, around off, Bairstow pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Mohammad Hasnain into the attack now.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Down the leg side again, a bit too full, Jonny boy misses his flick once more and it hit on the pads. A leg bye taken.
A huge shout for an LBW but turned down. Pitched well outside leg and hit too high as well. JB looked to flick but missed and was hit on the pads.
FOUR! Not quite where he intended but Bairstow will take it. Outside off, on a length, Jonny flashes hard and gets a thick outside edge. It flies past first slip and races to the third man fence.
Again on the leg side, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Around middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and Vince quickly  gets back. Pounces on the length in a trice and pummels it via a pull through mid-wicket.

FOUR! 'What has this guy eaten for breakfast?' pips my colleague who is as sharp as a knife. Off the 18 runs scored so far, 17 have been scored by Vince alone. Outside off, on a length, Vince leans and drives it through the covers!
Good ball, swinging in, around off, pushed towards mid on.
Around off, Vince looks to defend but the ball curls back in, and goes off the inner half wide of the bowler towards mid on.
Down the leg side, helped through square leg for a single.
Full and around off, swinging in, watchfully pushed out.
Around off, watchfully defended.

FOUR! Good shot, but... 'THAT SHOULD HAVE BEEN STOPPED,' laments a disappointed Waqar Younis on air. Full and outside off, Vince punches this through the covers. Imad Wasim gets across to his left, lazily sticks out his left hand but simply misses it. No dive, no extra effort, nothing. Happy to let the ball go. Generous.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Along middle and leg, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
SHAHEEN AFRIDI now.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Angling down the leg side, James looks to tuck but misses and is hit on the pads.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket where a good stop prevents runs.
Full and outside off, another gorgeous shot but this is intercepted by mid off.

FOUR! 'All the best, Pakistan!' says Waqar Younis on air. Outside off, on a length, Vince stands tall and punches it through the covers. Shoaib Malik gives it a chase or starts to, but then the ball runs down the hill and he gives it up.
FOUR! Good start to the day. Full and outside off, Vince reaches out and drives it through the covers!
The players are out in the middle. Hasan Ali to start off proceedings with the first new ball. James Vince and Jonny Bairstow are the openers for England. Here we go...

ENGLAND PLAYING XI - Jonny Bairstow (IN FOR JASON ROY), James Vince, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan (c) (IN FOR JOE DENLY), Jos Buttler (wk), Ben Stokes, Moeen Ali, Tom Curran, Chris Woakes (IN FOR JOFRA ARCHER), David Willey (IN FOR MARK WOOD) and Adil Rashid.

PAKISTAN PLAYING XI - Abid Ali (IN FOR IMAM-UL-HAQ), Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam, Shoaib Malik, Sarfaraz Ahmed (c and wk), Mohammad Hafeez, Asif Ali, Imad Wasim, Hasan Ali, Mohammad Hasnain and Shaheen Afridi (IN FOR JUNAID KHAN).

TEAM NEWS - For Pakistan, Abid Ali gets a game at last. With Imam-ul-Haq getting injured in the last game, the visitors have decided to rest him. Junaid Khan gets a break as well, with the smiling Shaheen Afridi replacing him. As far as England are concerned, they have four changes, with Morgan getting back in, along with Bairstow, Woakes and Willey. Roy, absent because of tending to his ill daughter, along with Vince, Wood and Archer miss out.

TOSS - Time for the all-important passage of the game. Normally, on flat beds like these, captain winning the toss wins the match because he opts to chase with conditions loaded fully in his team's favour. Eoin Morgan is back after serving his suspension and has won yet another toss. ENGLAND OPT TO BAT. Any surprises?

Pakistan are left with nothing but pride to play for. They have been slaughtered hard by the English batsmen but with a few catches taken and a few moments won, things would have been entirely different. But what is done is done. Pakistan would be hungry for a win now and would love to end the tour with a win hope to go into the World Cup with some sort of confidence. Hello and a warm welcome again, to the 5th and final ODI between England and Pakistan at Headingley, Leeds.

The fifth and final ODI is upon us! Welcome to the 'kill-all-the-bowlers' series. Batsmen keep getting the runs, bowlers struggle for help and eventually the umpires keep sigalling fours and sixes. England have already sealed the series in their favor with an inaccessible lead of 3-0 but would still be going all guns blazing as they will be preparing themselves for the big tournament.
